thread:
maya: Quick postmortem follow-up from the socket-handshake incident earlier — I pulled the action table into this thread so we can agree owners/timelines. TL;DR: repeated partial responses + timeouts on chat-stream -> client resumed causing duplicate partials.

kevin: thanks. main open items I see: 1) client-side more aggressive heartbeat/backoff, 2) server-side handshake idempotency, 3) observability: mark where partials emitted vs finalization.

maya: exactly. proposing owners: Kevin for client heartbeat/backoff RFC, Tess for handshake idempotency changes, Alex for observability/alerting. olivia can own the rollout verification.

kevin: I can take the heartbeat RFC. plan: add jittered exponential from client, add a lightweight heartbeat frame. target PR by 2026-04-04.

kevin: rough pseudo for client change:
```
// client heartbeat pseudocode
setInterval(() => {
  if (!connected) return
  send({type: 'heartbeat', seq: lastSeq})
}, heartbeatInterval * (1 + random()*0.2))
```

tess: for handshake idempotency, proposal is to introduce an ephemeral handshake token stored in server-side short-lived cache keyed by client_id+session_nonce. If we see replayed handshake we return 200 with existing session pointer instead of re-allocating. I'll draft design and perf implications. aiming EOD 2026-04-01 for design doc.

alex: observability tasks: 1) add metric stream.partial_emitted{route,model}, 2) add event when stream.finalized emitted, 3) tie alerts when partial_emitted > finalized for >5m in 1min windows. I'll file dashboards and alert rules. PR for dashboards by 2026-04-06.

olivia: I'll run the canary once changes land and verify no duplicate partials on our QA harness. Need a short checklist from devs to run.

maya: added a recurring pattern note: this appears in low-throughput customers during infra bursts where connection flaps cause duplicate resume attempts. We should track recurrence window (last 90 days) and tag affected customers.

alex: quick query I ran (approx):
```
select count(*) from stream_events
where event_type in ('partial_emitted','finalized')
and timestamp > now()-7d
group by session_id
having sum(case when event_type='partial_emitted' then 1 else 0 end) > sum(case when event_type='finalized' then 1 else 0 end)
limit 20;
```
Found ~14 sessions in past week showing partial>finalized. I'll paste IDs in the ticket.

maya: good. let's translate items to concrete tickets:
- RD-4001 Kevin: client heartbeat/backoff RFC + client SDK change (PR by 2026-04-10)
- RD-4002 Tess: handshake idempotency design + server change (design by 2026-04-01, PR by 2026-04-12)
- RD-4003 Alex: metrics+alerts+dashboards (PR by 2026-04-06)
- RD-4004 Olivia: canary verification checklist + run (verification by 2026-04-15)
- RD-4005 Maya: recurrence scan + customer tagging + weekly digest for 4 weeks (start 2026-04-01)

kevin: noted SLA impact: customers hitting this saw 15-25% higher perceived timeouts in chat flows. I'll include a rollback plan in the RFC.

tess: perf note: handshake cache uses Redis with 10s TTL, should be fine but will add local LRU on host to avoid extra RTTs. will include microbenchmarks.

sre-runbook: automated reminder: "Run RD-4005 recurrence scan" scheduled weekly on Mon 09:00 UTC for 4 weeks. :white_check_mark:

olivia: for the canary checklist I need the test script — Kevin/Tess can you add integration steps + expected logs? e.g., look for `stream.finalized` event and no duplicate `partial_emitted` from same session id.

kevin: will add integration steps to RD-4001 and include sample trace id pattern to grep for in logs. sample grep:
```
grep "session_id=abc123" /var/log/redwood/stream.log | grep partial_emitted
```

maya: schedule: we'll reconvene 2026-04-16 16:00 UTC for verification sync (post-rollout). If any PR slips, call it out in this thread and we re-plan.

kevin: acked. I'll post the RFC link when ready.

alex: filing RD-4003 now and linking dashboard stub.

olivia: I'll prep the QA harness changes today and add run instructions.

maya: thanks all. action owners — please update ticket fields (owner, target_date, verification steps). tagging @kevin @tess @alex @olivia for visibility. :pray:

oncall-bot: Incident tag applied: "socket-handshake-dup-partial-2026-03" — followups logged to RD-4001..RD-4005.

maya: I'll close the loop after the verification sync. if anything blocks, post updates here.
